# LUXFER SHAREHOLDERS APPROVE ACQUISITION BY WYNNCHURCH CAPITAL


### 4 November 2026


**RIVERSIDE, CA — November 4, 2026 — Luxfer Holdings PLC (NYSE: LXFR) (“Luxfer” or the “Company”)** ,


**** a global industrial company innovating niche applications in materials engineering, today announced that its shareholders voted to approve the Company's previously announced acquisition by affiliates of Wynnchurch Capital, L.P. (“Wynnchurch”) at two meetings of shareholders held earlier today in London, United Kingdom. Under the terms of the transaction, Company shareholders will receive $17.37 per share in cash upon completion of the transaction.


_


The transaction was approved by approximately 91.81% of the shares present in person or represented by proxy at the meeting of Company shareholders convened with the permission of the High Court of Justice in England and Wales, and by approximately 92.01% of the shares present in person or represented by proxy at the general meeting of Company shareholders.


“This transaction represents an important milestone for Luxfer,” said Andy Butcher, Chief Executive Officer of Luxfer. “We look forward to completing the transaction and beginning our next chapter with Wynnchurch Capital, while remaining focused on serving our customers and executing our business priorities.”


Completion of the transaction remains subject to the satisfaction or waiver of certain other customary closing conditions. The transaction is expected to close by the end of November 2026. Upon completion of the transaction, Luxfer will become a privately held company, and its ordinary shares will no longer be listed on the New York Stock Exchange.


Additional details regarding the voting results will be set forth in a Current Report on Form 8-K filed by the Company with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
